name: hydraulic-line
why: Routed tube in a real part: three 90 degree bends of one radius, bored along the same route, with a boss at each end and an O-ring gland turned into the inlet boss. The two-rim selector is what says the bore still runs the whole route — a bend radius that stopped fitting would break the chain and leave a different number. The gland is a catalogue section now, a 2.7 x 1.5 mm rectangle with 0.3 mm floor radii drawn as a revolve section, where it used to be a round-bottomed torus cut. By Pappus it removes 2 pi (w d (r + d/2) - 2 s (r + ds)) with r = 10.5, s = 0.09 - 0.0225 pi the spandrel area and ds = 0.3 (5/6 - pi/4)/(1 - pi/4) its centroid's inset: 283.712922 mm3. The exact B-rep (STEP probe) of the part with and without the cut differs by 19351.642732 - 19067.929810 = 283.712922. Coaxial seams like these in a cylinder wall once segfaulted UnifySameDomain, so the part is a second, in-context guard on the OCCT 8.0.1 fix that torus-gland holds directly.
